newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING unit Postbank launches Internet site.
newsitem.headline: ING unit Postbank launches Internet site.

text.p: Financial services group Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV's (ING) Postbank unit said on Wednesday all its services were now available electronically with the launch of its Internet site, Postbank Online.

Last month, Postbank launched a Windows version of its telebanking package, Girotel, a secure and closed system through which all payment orders/transmission business would be channelled for the time being.
"Using the potential of Postbank Online, plus that of Girotel, customers can now conduct all their banking business electronically," it said.

Postbank said the Internet site would offer general and topical information, such as stock market reports and 20 interactive consultancy items such as personalised mortgage options and customised payments.
Customers can send secure E-mail messages to the customer service department, receiving an answer the following day, and brochures and products can be ordered directly.
It said the Chipper stored-value card would eventually allow further integration of the Postbank Online and Girotel systems.
